# t_funcs.gaussian { #clerq.t_funcs.gaussian }

```python
t_funcs.gaussian(index)
```

Return a Gaussian pulse time function.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                           |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``fwhm_{index}``, ``centre_{index}``, |
|        | TFunc  | and either ``ampl_{index}`` or ``n_pi_{index}`` from args. Raises     |
|        | TFunc  | ``KeyError`` if both or neither amplitude parameters are present.     |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

The amplitude can be set directly via ``ampl_{index}`` or indirectly
via ``n_pi_{index}`` (desired pulse area in multiples of π).
